headline: You can do this. Start where you are.
lead: Videos, guided notes, practice, and help for math at Santa Ana College, organized by what you are learning to do, so you can find the right thing at the right moment.

steps.title: Learn it
steps.text: Short lectures, guided notes, and interactive apps for each outcome.

steps.title: Get unstuck
steps.text: FAQ guides by unit, and AI study partner prompts that ask you to try first.

steps.title: Check yourself
steps.text: Ungraded skill checks and practice sets so you know where you stand.

coursesSub: Pick a course to see its learning outcomes and everything tied to them.

moreCourses.title: More courses
moreCourses.text: Each course gets its own hub page, built from its learning outcomes. [Add a course]

principlesTitle: Built around what you are learning to do

principles.title: Outcome first
principles.text: Every course page starts from its learning outcomes, like S12 or S7. Textbooks change. Outcomes do not, so your resources stay where you left them.

principles.title: Many ways to learn
principles.text: Short videos, guided notes, interactive apps, and practice, grouped together so you can pick what works for you today.

principles.title: Help that coaches
principles.text: FAQ guides by unit, and AI study partner prompts built from real student questions. They ask you to try first.

band.title: Online and in the Math Center
band.text: The Academy is built to sit beside the Math Center. Tutors and the hub will use the same outcome codes, so "I am stuck on S12" means the same thing in both places.
